 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 5]
    top = min(r for r, c in pts)
    bottom = max(r for r, c in pts)
    left = min(c for r, c in pts)
    right = max(c for r, c in pts)
    markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 5)]
    # Identify the two outside marker colors, ordered from left to right.
    pair = sorted(markers, key=lambda p: p[1])
    a, b = pair[0][2], pair[1][2]
    marker_row = pair[0][0]
    inside_top, inside_bottom = top + 1, bottom - 1
    inside_left, inside_right = left + 1, right - 1
    split_r = (inside_top + inside_bottom + 1) // 2
    split_c = (inside_left + inside_right + 1) // 2
    marker_is_above = marker_row < top
    for r in range(inside_top, inside_bottom + 1):
        for c in range(inside_left, inside_right + 1):
            upper = r < split_r
            left_half = c < split_c
            same_side = (upper == marker_is_above)
            out[r][c] = (a if left_half else b) if same_side else (b if left_half else a)
    return out
"
